```{bash, download-metadata, eval=FALSE}
mkdir -p data
# download the sample metadata v1.4 from GitHub, make sure you download this into "sample_metadata_file" defined in .Rprofile
wget -nc -O data/IHEC_sample_metadata_harmonization.v1.4_extended.csv https://raw.githubusercontent.com/IHEC/epiATLAS-metadata-harmonization/748afe0bd4167235f09c857937c5c8b62f9f49f5/openrefine/v1.4/IHEC_sample_metadata_harmonization.v1.4_extended.csv
# download experiment metadata and qc summaries from sftp
echo "get IHEC/readme/EpiATLAS_experiment_metadata.csv data/" | sftp sftp.bcgsc.ca
echo "get IHEC/readme/*_qc_summary.csv data/" | sftp sftp.bcgsc.ca
echo "get IHEC/post_processed_data/ChIP-Seq_imputed/imputation_primarymetrics.txt data/" | sftp sftp.bcgsc.ca

mkdir -p processed_data
```

```{r, find-epirr-ids}
# Load sample metadata
metadata <- fread(sample_metadata_file)
### make a list of all epirr_ids which contain RNA-Seq, WGBS and observed or imputed ChIP-Seq data
# first subset the metadata to only include the columns epirr_id and automated_experiments*
experiment_cols <- metadata[, c("epirr_id_without_version", grep("automated_experiments", names(metadata), value = TRUE))]
experiment_dt <- metadata[, ..experiment_cols]
# remove imputed WGBS imputed entries, because we do not use them
experiment_dt[automated_experiments_WGBS_standard == 'imputed', automated_experiments_WGBS_standard := ""]
# fill empty cells in WGBS column with PBAT column
experiment_dt[automated_experiments_WGBS_standard == "", automated_experiments_WGBS_standard := automated_experiments_WGBS_PBAT]
# create RNA-Seq column with mRNA-seq and total RNA-seq if mRNA-Seq is empty
experiment_dt[, `automated_experiments_RNA-Seq` := `automated_experiments_RNA-Seq_mRNA-Seq`]
experiment_dt[`automated_experiments_RNA-Seq` == "", `automated_experiments_RNA-Seq` := `automated_experiments_RNA-Seq_total-RNA-Seq`]

# get chip-seq cols
chip_seq_cols <- grep("automated_experiments_ChIP-Seq", names(experiment_dt), value = TRUE)
# check if all chip-seq columns are filled
full_chip <- rowSums(experiment_dt[, lapply(.SD, function(x) x == ""), .SDcols = chip_seq_cols]) == 0
# get epirr_ids which have all three data types
epirr_ids_to_use <- experiment_dt[full_chip & automated_experiments_WGBS_standard != "" & `automated_experiments_RNA-Seq` != "", epirr_id_without_version]
rna_seq_epirrs <- experiment_dt[`automated_experiments_RNA-Seq` != "", epirr_id_without_version]
```

```{r, select-data-to-download}
# subset metadata again using the epirr_ids we want to use, but drag along the rna_seq_epirrs
download_metadata <- metadata[epirr_id_without_version %in% epirr_ids_to_use, ..experiment_cols]
# melt data table
download_metadata <- melt(download_metadata, id.vars = "epirr_id_without_version", variable.name = "column", value.name = "uuid", na.rm = TRUE)
rna_only_metadata <- melt(metadata[epirr_id_without_version %in% setdiff(rna_seq_epirrs, epirr_ids_to_use), .(epirr_id_without_version, `automated_experiments_RNA-Seq_mRNA-Seq`, `automated_experiments_RNA-Seq_total-RNA-Seq`)],
                          id.vars = "epirr_id_without_version", variable.name = "column", value.name = "uuid", na.rm = TRUE)
download_metadata <- rbind(download_metadata, rna_only_metadata)

# split the column names to get the assay type and experiment type
download_metadata <- download_metadata[, c("assay_type", "experiment_type"):=tstrsplit(column, "_", fixed = TRUE, keep=c(3, 4))]
# remove imputed WGBS data
download_metadata[assay_type == 'WGBS' & uuid == 'imputed', uuid := NA]
# set empty uuids to NA
download_metadata[uuid == "", uuid := NA]
# get the epirr_ids which have both RNA-Seq types and set the totalRN to NA
# both_RNA <- download_metadata[assay_type == 'RNA-Seq', if(.SD[, sum(!is.na(uuid)) > 1]).(both_RNA=TRUE), by=epirr_id_without_version]
# download_metadata[epirr_id_without_version %in% both_RNA[, epirr_id_without_version] & experiment_type == 'total-RNA-Seq', uuid := NA]
# remove empty uuids

download_metadata <- download_metadata[!is.na(uuid)]
# make sure we have 405 entries with 3 different assays and at least 8 different entries (some have more because we have some with both RNA assays)
stopifnot(download_metadata[epirr_id_without_version %in% epirr_ids_to_use, .(unique_assays=uniqueN(assay_type), unique_experiments=uniqueN(experiment_type)), by = epirr_id_without_version][, all(unique_assays == 3) & all(unique_experiments >= 8)])
```


```{r, check-qc}
# read experiment metadata for observed data
experiment_metadata <- fread("data/EpiATLAS_experiment_metadata.csv", stringsAsFactors = TRUE) # from https://ihec.sd4h.ca/IHEC/readme/EpiATLAS_experiment_metadata.csv
experiment_metadata[, uuid := as.character(uuid)]

# get qc files https://ihec.sd4h.ca/IHEC/readme/*_qc_summary.csv
rna_qc <- fread("data/EpiATLAS_rnaseq_qc_summary.csv", stringsAsFactors = TRUE)
rna_qc[, uuid := as.character(uuid)]
rna_qc[experiment_metadata, on=c(uuid="uuid"), c("experiment_type", "trimmed_read_length", "paired_end", "analyzed_as_stranded"):=.(experiment_type, trimmed_read_length, paired_end, analyzed_as_stranded)]
rna_qc[, trimmed_read_length := sapply(strsplit(as.character(trimmed_read_length), ";", fixed = TRUE), function(x) {stopifnot(length(unique(x)) == 1); as.integer(unique(x))})]
rna_qc[is.na(trimmed_read_length), stopifnot(uuid == "d1be4297-a068-438f-83fa-0cc62223cc56")]
rna_qc[is.na(trimmed_read_length), trimmed_read_length := 36L]

rna_qc[, included := "EpiATLAS"]
rna_qc[uuid %in% download_metadata[assay_type == "RNA-Seq", uuid], included := "this_project"]
# ggplot(rna_qc, aes(x = total)) + geom_density() + facet_grid(experiment_type ~ included) + geom_vline(xintercept = 45e6, linetype='dashed') + labs(title = "Total Reads Density Plot")
# ggplot(rna_qc, aes(x = fraction_mapped)) + geom_density() + facet_grid(experiment_type ~ included) + geom_vline(xintercept = .5, linetype='dashed') + labs(title = "Fraction Mapped Density Plot")
# ggplot(rna_qc, aes(x = fraction_intergenic)) + geom_density() + facet_grid(experiment_type ~ included) + geom_vline(xintercept = .15, linetype='dashed') + labs(title = "Fraction Intergenic Density Plot")
# ggplot(rna_qc, aes(x = fraction_rrna)) + geom_density() + facet_grid(experiment_type ~ included) + geom_vline(xintercept = .3, linetype='dashed') + labs(title = "Fraction rRNA Density Plot")
# ggplot(rna_qc, aes(x = fraction_duplicates)) + geom_density() + facet_grid(experiment_type ~ included) + geom_vline(xintercept = 0.95, linetype='dashed') + labs(title = "Fraction Duplicated Density Plot")
# ggplot(rna_qc, aes(x = fraction_duplicates, color = data_generating_centre)) + geom_density() + facet_grid( ~ experiment_type) + geom_vline(xintercept = .4, linetype='dashed') + labs(title = "Fraction Duplicated Density Plot")
rna_qc[, rna_potentially_problematic := FALSE]
rna_qc[total < 45e6 | fraction_mapped < .5 | fraction_intergenic > .15 | fraction_rrna > .3 | fraction_duplicates > 0.95, rna_potentially_problematic := TRUE]
rna_qc[, epirr_id_without_version := tstrsplit(epirr_id, ".", fixed = TRUE, keep = 1)]
rna_qc_stats <- c("epirr_id_without_version", "uuid", "rna_potentially_problematic", "fraction_mapped", "fraction_intergenic", "fraction_rrna", "fraction_duplicates")

chip_qc <- fread("data/EpiATLAS_chipseq_qc_summary.csv", stringsAsFactors = TRUE)
chip_qc[, uuid := as.character(uuid)]
chip_qc_stats <- names(chip_qc)[!names(chip_qc) %in% c( "uuid", "data_generating_centre", "epirr_id", "antibody")]
chip_qc[, included := "EpiATLAS"]
chip_qc[uuid %in% download_metadata[assay_type == "ChIP-Seq", uuid], included := "this_project"]
# ggplot(chip_qc, aes(x = `flagstat_qc:mapped_pct`)) + geom_density() + facet_grid(antibody ~ included) + geom_vline(xintercept = 60, linetype='dashed') + labs(title = "Mapped Reads Density Plot")
# ggplot(chip_qc, aes(x = `flagstat_qc:paired_properly_pct`)) + geom_density() + facet_grid(antibody ~ included) + geom_vline(xintercept = 90, linetype='dashed') + labs(title = "Paired Properly Reads Density Plot")
# ggplot(chip_qc, aes(x = `dup_qc:dupes_pct`)) + geom_density() + facet_grid(antibody ~ included) + geom_vline(xintercept = 90, linetype='dashed') + labs(title = "Duplicates Density Plot")
# ggplot(chip_qc, aes(x = `pbc_qc:NRF`)) + geom_density() + facet_grid(antibody ~ included) + geom_vline(xintercept = .5, linetype='dashed') + labs(title = " Non-Redundant Fraction (NRF) and PCR Bottlenecking Coefficients 1 and 2 Density Plot")
# ggplot(chip_qc, aes(x = `pbc_qc:PBC1`)) + geom_density() + facet_grid(antibody ~ included) + geom_vline(xintercept = .5, linetype='dashed') + labs(title = "PCR Bottlenecking Coefficients 1 Density Plot")
# ggplot(chip_qc, aes(x = `pbc_qc:PBC2`)) + geom_density() + facet_grid(antibody ~ included) + geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype='dashed') + labs(title = "PCR Bottlenecking Coefficients 2 Density Plot")
# ggplot(chip_qc, aes(x = `frip_macs2_qc:rep1.FRiP`)) + geom_density() + facet_grid(antibody ~ included) + geom_vline(xintercept = .1, linetype='dashed') + labs(title = "Fraction of Reads in Peaks Density Plot")
# ggplot(chip_qc, aes(x = `overlap_frip_qc:rep1-pr.FRiP`)) + geom_density() + facet_grid(antibody ~ included) + geom_vline(xintercept = .1, linetype='dashed') + labs(title = "Fraction of Reads in Peaks across Replicates Density Plot")
chip_qc[, potentially_problematic := FALSE]
chip_qc_stats <- c("potentially_problematic", chip_qc_stats)
# removed : | `flagstat_qc:paired_properly_pct` < 90 
chip_qc[`flagstat_qc:mapped_pct` < 60 | `dup_qc:dupes_pct` > 90 | `pbc_qc:NRF` < .5 | `pbc_qc:PBC1` < .5 | `pbc_qc:PBC2` < 1 | `frip_macs2_qc:rep1.FRiP` < .02 | `overlap_frip_qc:rep1-pr.FRiP` < .02, potentially_problematic := TRUE]
chip_qc[, epirr_id_without_version := tstrsplit(epirr_id, ".", fixed = TRUE, keep = 1)]
chip_qc_long <- melt(chip_qc, id.vars = c("epirr_id_without_version", "potentially_problematic", "included", "antibody"), measure.vars = chip_qc_stats)
chip_qc_wide <- dcast(chip_qc_long, epirr_id_without_version + included ~ antibody + variable)

wgbs_qc <- fread("data/EpiATLAS_wgbs_qc_summary.csv", stringsAsFactors = TRUE)
wgbs_qc[, uuid := as.character(uuid)]
wgbs_qc[, included := "EpiATLAS"]
wgbs_qc[uuid %in% download_metadata[assay_type == "WGBS", uuid], included := "this_project"]
wgbs_qc[experiment_metadata, on=c(uuid="uuid"), c("experiment_type"):=.(experiment_type)]
# ggplot(wgbs_qc, aes(x = `Mean_CpG_Coverage`)) + geom_density() + facet_grid(experiment_type ~ included) + geom_vline(xintercept = 3, linetype='dashed') + labs(title = "Mean CpG Coverage Density Plot")
# ggplot(wgbs_qc, aes(x = `BS_conversion_Rate`)) + geom_density() + facet_grid(experiment_type ~ included) + geom_vline(xintercept = .95, linetype='dashed') + labs(title = "Bisulfite Conversion Rate Density Plot")
# ggplot(wgbs_qc, aes(x = `GC_cov_Correlation`)) + geom_density() + facet_grid(experiment_type ~ included) + geom_vline(xintercept = c(-.7, .7), linetype='dashed') + labs(title = "GC Coverage Correlation Density Plot")
wgbs_qc[, wgbs_potentially_problematic := FALSE]
wgbs_qc[`Mean_CpG_Coverage` < 3 | `BS_conversion_Rate` < .95 | `GC_cov_Correlation` < -.7 | `GC_cov_Correlation` > .7 , wgbs_potentially_problematic := TRUE]
wgbs_qc[, epirr_id_without_version := tstrsplit(epirr_id, ".", fixed = TRUE, keep = 1)]
wgbs_qc_stats <- c("epirr_id_without_version", "wgbs_potentially_problematic", "Mean_CpG_Coverage", "BS_conversion_Rate", "GC_cov_Correlation")

# now merge all three qc tables based on epirr_id_without_version but only the ones where included == "this_project"
merged_qc <-
  merge(
    merge(chip_qc_wide[included == "this_project", -"included"], 
          rna_qc[included == "this_project", ..rna_qc_stats], 
          by = "epirr_id_without_version",
          all = TRUE), 
    wgbs_qc[included == "this_project", ..wgbs_qc_stats],
    by = "epirr_id_without_version",
    all = TRUE
  )
fwrite(merged_qc, "processed_data/qc_summary.csv")

download_metadata[epirr_id_without_version %in% epirr_ids_to_use, table(experiment_type, uuid %in% c(rna_qc[rna_potentially_problematic == TRUE, uuid], chip_qc[potentially_problematic == TRUE, uuid], wgbs_qc[wgbs_potentially_problematic == TRUE, uuid]))]
download_metadata[epirr_id_without_version %in% epirr_ids_to_use & uuid %in% c(rna_qc[rna_potentially_problematic == TRUE, uuid], chip_qc[potentially_problematic == TRUE, uuid], wgbs_qc[wgbs_potentially_problematic == TRUE, uuid]), uniqueN(epirr_id_without_version)]
potentially_remove_epirr <- download_metadata[uuid %in% c(rna_qc[rna_potentially_problematic == TRUE, uuid], chip_qc[potentially_problematic == TRUE, uuid], wgbs_qc[wgbs_potentially_problematic == TRUE, uuid]), unique(epirr_id_without_version)]
metadata[epirr_id_without_version %in% epirr_ids_to_use, table(harmonized_sample_ontology_term_high_order_fig1, epiATLAS_status)]
metadata[epirr_id_without_version %in% epirr_ids_to_use & ! epirr_id_without_version %in% potentially_remove_epirr, table(harmonized_sample_ontology_term_high_order_fig1, epiATLAS_status)]
```


```{r, make-ftp-list}
# add epirr_id for the specific version and software version
download_metadata[experiment_metadata, on=.NATURAL, c("epirr_id", "software_version"):=.(epirr_id, software_version)]

# read experiment metadata for observed +imputed data
imputed_experiment_metadata <- fread("data/EpiATLAS_imputed_experiment_metadata.csv") # from https://ihec.sd4h.ca/IHEC/readme/EpiATLAS_imputed_experiment_metadata.csv
# add epirr_id for the specific version and data_path
imputed_experiment_metadata[, epirr_id_without_version:=tstrsplit(epirr_id, ".", fixed=TRUE, keep=1)]
imputed_experiment_metadata[, uuid := 'imputed']
imputed_experiment_metadata[, experiment_type := mark]
download_metadata[imputed_experiment_metadata, on=c('epirr_id_without_version', 'uuid', 'experiment_type'), c("epirr_id", "data_file_path"):=.(i.epirr_id, data_file_path)]

# create the file paths from filenames
download_metadata[assay_type == 'ChIP-Seq', filename := paste("ihec.chipseq.ihec-chipseq-containerv1.1.4", epirr_id, uuid ,"pval.signal.bigwig", sep = '.')]
download_metadata[assay_type == 'RNA-Seq', filename := paste("ihec.rna-seq.ihec-grapenf-containerv1.1.0", epirr_id, uuid ,"isoforms.results", sep = '.')]
download_metadata[, file_path := file.path('IHEC/base_data', epirr_id_without_version, experiment_type, filename)]
# different path for imputed ChIP-Seq data
download_metadata[uuid == 'imputed', file_path := sub('incoming', "IHEC/post_processed_data", data_file_path, fixed = TRUE)]
# write the downloaded files to file for later 
fwrite(download_metadata, "processed_data/file_table.csv.gz")
# we download WGBS data using the post processed WGBS matrices
wgbs_matrices <- paste0("IHEC/post_processed_data/WGBS_matrices/meth10/chr", seq.int(22), ".meth10.csv.gz")
final_paths <- c(download_metadata[assay_type != 'WGBS', file_path], wgbs_matrices)
writeLines(final_paths, "processed_data/ftp_paths.txt")
# now you can download the files in ftp_paths.txt
```
